question: A vessel contains 60 litres of a mixture of milk and water in which milk is 45 litres. 20 litres of the mixture is taken out and replaced with water. What is the new ratio of milk to water?
question_ne: एउटा भाँडामा 60 लिटर दूध र पानीको मिश्रण छ, जसमा दूध 45 लिटर छ। 20 लिटर मिश्रण निकालेर पानी हालियो। दूध र पानीको नयाँ अनुपात कति हो?
explanation: Milk removed = 20x45/60 = 15 L. Milk left = 45 - 15 = 30 L. Water = 60 - 30 = 30 L. Ratio = 1:1.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal

question_ne: A र B एक्लैले काम क्रमशः 15 र 30 दिनमा सक्न सक्छन्। उनीहरू 3 दिन सँगै काम गर्छन् र त्यसपछि A जान्छ। B ले बाँकी काम कति दिनमा सक्न सक्छ?
explanation: Work done in 3 days = 3x(1/15 + 1/30) = 0.300. Remaining = 0.700. B needs 0.700x30 = 21 more days.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal

question: A car goes from A to B at 30 km/h and returns at 90 km/h. What is its average speed for the whole journey?
question_ne: एउटा कार A बाट B सम्म 30 किमी/घण्टामा जान्छ र 90 किमी/घण्टामा फर्कन्छ। सम्पूर्ण यात्राको औसत गति कति हो?
explanation: Average speed = 2 x 30 x 90 / (30 + 90) = 45 km/h.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal

question: 20 men can finish a work in 30 days. In how many days can 60 men finish the same work?
question_ne: 20 जना मानिसले एउटा काम 30 दिनमा सक्न सक्छन्। 60 जनाले उही काम कति दिनमा सक्न सक्छन्?
explanation: Total work = 20x30 = 600 man-days. Days for 60 men = 600/60 = 10.
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
